# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Every morning you wake up, a battle is already waiting. Not against flesh and blood, but against apathy, distraction, and the quiet pull to coast through another day. Joshua faced the same weight. Moses was dead, the Jordan stood in front of him, and the promise of God seemed impossible. Yet God didn't tell him to feel brave—He commanded him to be strong and courageous, and He gave the reason: "the LORD your God is with you wherever you go."

That's your anchor, brother. Courage isn't the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of it. You don't need to manufacture strength on your own—you need to show up, trust the God who goes before you, and take the next faithful step. Whether that's leading your family, honoring your word, or simply getting out of bed to face hard things, you don't face them alone. The Commander of the armies of heaven walks with you. So rise. Battle the day with your eyes on Him, not on the size of the obstacle.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups as you wake—each one a prayer: "Lord, make me strong and courageous today."
